judge.what: Hazard explains how to permanently store weapons and cash in GTA 6 to avoid losing them when busted or wasted.

subs.text: For starters, you shouldn't shy away
from buying good weapons and customizing them, as the weapons you purchase
will get permanently added to your inventory.
But the weapons that you pick from your enemies will be lost if you die or get busted.
So to save them, simply open the trunk of Jason's Vapid Granado and store them.
